title: Polling begins for Vijayawada Municipal Corporation, 92 urban local bodies in Andhra Pradesh | LIVE
description: Elections in eight Municipalities and Nagar Panchayats — Allagadda, Dachepalli, Darsi, Gurajala, Kamalapuram, Piduguralla, Proddatur and Rayachoti — were unanimous, with both chairpersons and ward members elected unopposed
